description: Check that numbers, units, part numbers, tolerance signs, dates, placeholders and URLs survive translation — For aligned source and target segments, extracts the tokens a translation must not change (numbers with attached units or %, ISO dates, part numbers and versions, tolerance and comparison operators such as ± ≤ ≥, placeholders like {0} or %s, URLs and emails) and reports any that are missing, added or altered, with offsets in both texts in UTF-16, code points, UTF-8 bytes and graphemes.
